title: Cloud Computing
tagline: Design, deploy, and manage scalable applications on AWS, Azure, and GCP.
description: Cloud platforms now run most of the world's software. This program builds real, hands-on fluency across AWS, Azure, and GCP — compute, storage, networking, security, and cost management — so you can design and run production-grade cloud infrastructure, not just pass a quiz about it.
outcomes: Design and deploy scalable applications across AWS, Azure, and GCP
Manage cloud compute, storage, and networking services
Apply cloud security and cost-optimization best practices
Automate infrastructure provisioning instead of clicking through consoles

topics: Choosing the right cloud for a workload

projects: Deploy a scalable web application with auto-scaling and load balancing
Design a multi-tier cloud architecture with a cost estimate

faqs.q: Do I need to know all three cloud providers already?
faqs.a: No — you'll go deep on AWS first, then see how the same concepts map onto Azure and GCP.

faqs.q: Will I get my own cloud environment to practice in?
faqs.a: Yes — every module includes hands-on labs in real cloud accounts, not simulations.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
